notes:
## Changes

- **Credits and your privacy, on the About page.** It now lists everything Video Shelf is built with and the licence each comes under, with links. It also says plainly what stays on your PC and the only times the app goes online.
- **Video details are read by ffprobe directly.** The length, codecs and frame size of each video now come straight from ffprobe, the one you already have with ffmpeg, rather than through a separate library. Nothing changes in how you use it.
